features.name: Circle Spells
features.description: Circle spells: entangle/goodberry (L2), barkskin/spike growth (L3), speak with plants/vine carpet (L5), dreamwine/hallucinatory terrain (L7), enchanted bloom/tree stride (L9). Always prepared.

features.name: Summon Green Spirit
features.description: At 2nd level, expend one Wild Shape to summon a Green Spirit within 30 ft. Friendly, obeys your commands, shares initiative (acts after you). Uses your PB. Lasts 1 hour. Bears 10 goodberry-like fruit. See stat block for details.

features.name: Gift of the Green
features.description: At 6th level, once per spirit summon, cast one of: locate animals or plants, pass without trace, plant growth, or speak with plants without slot/components. When you cast a healing spell while spirit is summoned, +1d8 to healing. Spells can originate from you or your spirit.

features.name: Verdant Interference
features.description: Starting at 10th level, when a creature within 30 ft of you or your green spirit is attacked, use reaction to cause vines to give the attacker disadvantage until your next turn. Prof bonus uses/long rest.

payload.name: Verdant Interference
payload.description: Give an attacker disadvantage until your next turn when ally within 30 ft is attacked.

features.name: Spirit Symbiosis
features.description: At 14th level, join with your green spirit as action while it's within 30 ft. Gain temp HP = spirit's current HP, 30 ft climb speed, advantage on CON saves, hostile creatures within 10 ft have difficult terrain, tendril attack as bonus action (2d8 + WIS bludgeoning, 10 ft). Lasts until temp HP = 0 or spirit duration ends.
